15	# AEVO-X: 3-Loop Self-Evolution System
16	
17	## Overview
18	
19	Replace the current single-speed evolution loop (starving at ~1 cycle/month) with a 3-loop architecture that achieves 100+ evolution cycles/month via synthetic replay, grounds fitness in revenue outcomes, and enables DGM-style self-rewriting of evolution code itself.
20	
21	**Target repo:** `D:\code\invesments\master_investments`
22	**Target location:** `.claude/lib/intelligence/evolution/`
23	**Brainstorm:** [brainstorm-report.md](./brainstorm-report.md)
24	
25	## Architecture
26	
27	```
28	Loop 1 (minutes): Case Archive → Strategy Mutation → Deterministic Replay → Fitness Score
29	Loop 2 (days):    Live /stage0 → Verdict+Trace → Founder Action → Outcome Report
30	Loop 3 (weeks):   Loop1+2 signals → LLM Proposer → Code Rewrite → Test → Validate
31	```
32	
33	Loop 2 calibrates Loop 1 fidelity. Loop 3 rewrites Loop 1+2 code.
34	
35	## Phases
36	
37	| Phase | Name | Status | Effort | Deps |
38	|-------|------|--------|--------|------|
39	| 1 | [Case Archiver + DB Schema](./phase-01-case-archiver-db-schema.md) | ✅ Complete | 2d | - |
40	| 2 | [Replay Engine (Deterministic)](./phase-02-replay-engine-deterministic.md) | ✅ Complete | 3d | 1 |
41	| 3 | [Execution Fitness Tracker](./phase-03-execution-fitness-tracker.md) | ✅ Complete | 2d | - |
42	| 4 | [Fidelity Monitor](./phase-04-fidelity-monitor.md) | ✅ Complete | 1d | 2,3 |
43	| 5 | [DGM Proposer + Benchmark](./phase-05-dgm-proposer-benchmark.md) | ✅ Complete | 3d | 2 |
44	| 6 | [Orchestrator + Hook Wiring](./phase-06-orchestrator-hook-wiring.md) | ✅ Complete | 2d | 1-5 |
45	| 7 | [Integration Tests + Smoke](./phase-07-integration-tests-smoke.md) | ✅ Complete | 1d | 6 |
46	
47	**Parallel tracks:** Phase 1+3 can run in parallel. Phase 2+5 depend on 1. Phase 4 needs 2+3.
48	
49	## Key Decisions
50	
51	- **Storage:** SQLite (`data/evolution/replay-archive.db`) — fast queries, indexed
52	- **Cache depth:** Full agent outputs + raw WebSearch results (~500KB-2MB/case)
53	- **DGM scope:** Evolution infra ONLY (mutator, fitness, selector, replay_engine) — cannot touch stage0 pipeline
54	- **Trigger:** After each /stage0 + daily cron for tournament cycle
55	- **TDD mode:** Tests written FIRST per phase to lock existing behavior before modification
56	
57	## Dependencies
58	
59	No cross-plan blockers. The distribution-intelligence-tool plan (260509) is independent domain.

16	
17	## Overview
18	
19	A `Stop` hook (`stage2-audit-completion.cjs`) that fires after every assistant turn, detects output type, loads matching audit schema, runs D1-D7 dimension checks, and either passes (exit 0) or blocks with structured gap injection (exit 2) to drive self-correction loops. Convergence safety prevents infinite loops.
20	
21	**Source:** `plans/reports/brainstorm-260517-stage2-universal-audit-completion-engine.md`

24	
25	- Pure CJS (no Python, no LLM calls in hook) — regex/string ops only
26	- Per-session audit history (no cross-session state)
27	- Only critical/major gaps block; minors tagged [RESIDUAL] and passed
28	- Convergence: max 5 iterations, stagnation detection, repeat gap marking
29	- Runs LAST after existing hooks (research-output-validator, stage0-post-audit)
